impact: Asian memory and chip names are holding up, a mild support for MU, DRAM and SKM, but Nvidia's after-hours slide and Nasdaq futures down about 1% could still weigh at the US open.
summary: Asian stocks extended gains on Thursday even as traders watched Nvidia's leadership crisis. By midday the Nikkei 225 was up about 0.8% at 61,714 and the Kospi up about 1.2% at 5,464, while Hong Kong's Hang Seng fell about 1.1% to 24,044. Samsung opened up about 1.7% after the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 5.66% on Wednesday.
title: Asia extends gains despite Nvidia crisis: Kospi +1.2%, Nikkei +0.8%
